drill.name: 会员空间平台 · 应用回滚演练

steps.title: 预检（环境变量 / 镜像标签 / compose 解析）
steps.detail: 预检项: APP_IMAGE_REPO, APP_CURRENT_TAG, APP_ROLLBACK_TAG, DRILL_API_BASE_URL, NGINX_HTTP_PORT, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB, COMPOSE_FILE + 两个镜像标签 + compose 解析（dry-run 不做实际校验）
commands: APP_IMAGE=member-space-drill/app:1.0.0 APP_IMAGE_TAG=1.0.0 docker compose -f app-rollback-drill/drill/docker-compose.yml --env-file app-rollback-drill/.env --project-name member-space-drill config -q

steps.title: 记录回滚前状态（docker ps / compose ps / version）
steps.detail: 计划：采集回滚前 docker ps / compose ps / version
commands: APP_IMAGE=member-space-drill/app:1.0.0 APP_IMAGE_TAG=1.0.0 docker compose -f app-rollback-drill/drill/docker-compose.yml --env-file app-rollback-drill/.env --project-name member-space-drill config -q

steps.title: 切镜像版本（渲染并校验目标镜像引用）
steps.detail: 计划：以 APP_IMAGE_TAG=0.2.0 渲染 compose 并校验镜像引用为 member-space-drill/app:0.2.0
commands: APP_IMAGE=member-space-drill/app:1.0.0 APP_IMAGE_TAG=1.0.0 docker compose -f app-rollback-drill/drill/docker-compose.yml --env-file app-rollback-drill/.env --project-name member-space-drill config -q
